display_name: Test: patrols and the player by walls, corridors and locked doors
description: Engine test for the q53 wall rule: fixed-waypoint patrols hugging a wall, through a one-tile gap and toward a closed locked door.
test_objective: Verify a patrol walking into a player beside a wall, a corridor or a closed door never passes through him, never puts him into a wall or across the locked door, and a paused patrol in a one-tile gap never soft-locks him.
